summary: Separate a simple delimited value into an array.
documentation: split finds separator boundaries and returns the pieces as an array. A string separator is matched literally; repeated separators can produce empty strings.
inputs: A string separator or regular expression, and an optional result limit.
caution: This exercise is simple comma-separated text, not quoted CSV. Empty fields remain empty strings.
scenarios: Read a simple set of comma-separated product tags.
Break a known-format reference into its parts.
Split a multi-line text import into lines.
title: Read the raw service fields
problem: Split the input string at each comma. Do not trim fields or remove empty fields. An empty input string must produce an array containing one empty string.
goal: Use String.split() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
